narr: A short wave trough aloft approached the Mid-Atlantic from the west on July 9. Strong thunderstorms formed during the afternoon and evening with gusty winds and heavy rainfall moving into the lower Maryland Eastern Shore in the evening hours.
ev: A county official reported 3 to 4 inches of water on the typical flood prone roads across the town of Crisfield.
A member of the public reported a rainfall total of 3.73 inches. Some roads were underwater.
